scope: Authenticate a caller-pinned clean checkout, its imported project modules, preserved public evidence, and the declared numerical/HTTP machine. This preflight does not load private artifacts, execute a forward, read protected records, or authorize any protected-data access.
source_binding: The caller supplies the reviewed full Git commit and this contract's byte SHA-256. Require the supplied root itself to be the Git top-level directory, the exact commit, and no tracked or untracked changes. Authenticate tracked Python files only under src/automated_phishing_detection and scripts, plus pyproject.toml, uv.lock, this contract, and the exact public map below. Compare no-follow regular-file bytes with committed blobs; reject symlink components, aliases, missing files and unsupported Git modes. Ignored data and artifact paths are never traversed.
import_binding: Every currently imported automated_phishing_detection module must have its file and spec origin in the authenticated source set under this root; package search paths must stay in that source package. Recheck after artifact loading or late imports and before execution. This verifies source identity, not the absence of arbitrary in-memory monkeypatching.
runtime_checks: Require each runtime distribution version above and the imported scientific/HTTP module versions, Darwin arm64, the exact nonidentifying machine/OS fields, built and available MPS, and NumPy scipy-openblas 0.3.29 (optional vendor build suffix beginning '.', '-' or '+'). Both named MPS environment flags must be absent or exactly '0', normalized to disabled. No fallback, backend substitution or development-tool pinning is authorized. Probe one-thread capability in a short restoring context after querying fresh-owner Torch thread state; never run a forward or change deterministic mode.
recheck: Reauthenticate the same commit, contract, selected file bytes, current imported project module paths and runtime identity. Compare no timestamps or preexisting thread-count observations; a valid late import from an already authenticated source file is allowed. Runtime probes must run in an otherwise idle isolated process, before owner-thread scoring sessions.
remaining_bindings: Reviewed artifact loader and no-overwrite measurement runner with private artifact and realized manifest identity
Complete secondary/source pre-access freeze; this binding alone does not unlock protected evaluation
